title: Autofarm
features:
Autofarm.

Okay apparently there are way faster ones :/ I didn't put too much time in this.
script:
local star = nil
local plr = game.Players.LocalPlayer
for _, p in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
    if p.Name == "Star" and p.Material == Enum.Material.Plastic then
        star = p
    end
end

if not star then plr:Kick("Please rejoin") end
while wait(2.1) do
    pcall(function()
        plr.Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart").CFrame = star.CFrame
        if star.Transparency == 1 then
            plr.Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart").CFrame = workspace:FindFirstChild("Gift", true).Parent.Rebirth.CFrame
        end
    end)
end
